name: Should I paint the ceiling in my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Should I paint the ceiling in my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, painting the bathroom ceiling is generally recommended. The ceiling is also exposed to humidity and steam, making it susceptible to mildew and discoloration. Using a paint specifically designed for bathrooms, often with mildew-resistant properties and a flat or eggshell finish, helps maintain a clean, fresh look throughout the entire space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, painting the bathroom ceiling with mildew-resistant paint is recommended to combat humidity and maintain a clean appearance.
